test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Five person A, B, C, D and E are sitting in a row facing towards north (not necessarily in the same order). Each of them are preparing for different competitive exam C1, C2, C3, C4 and C5 (not necessarily in the same order). No two persons are preparing for same exam. Only two persons sit between A and the one who is preparing for C3. D sits to the immediate right of B and B is preparing for C5. Only one person sits between D and E. One among D and E sits at one of the extreme end. A is not neighbour of B. One person sits between the persons who are preparing for C3 and C1. The one preparing for C1 sits to the immediate left of the one who is preparing for C5. C is not preparing for C4. Who is preparing for C2?
solution:
**Given:** Five person A, B, C, D and E are sitting in a row facing towards north. Each of them are preparing for different competitive exam C1, C2, C3, C4 and C5. No two persons are preparing for same exam. 

1) One among D and E sits at one of the extreme end.

2) D sits to the immediate right of B and B is preparing for C5. 

3) Only one person sits between D and E.

As position of E in a row is not known yet, therefore there are two possible cases.

Case 1)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9a6250fb3baf4eb7b41ddbd0b3129d174f505e5db86655a013412cd4f68d7e82.png] 

Case 2)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d15220bb0333ed286f1db182c2413c6821108f4ce30a38e6075213ecd650c536.png] 

Case 3) 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79cf3218620fd35592c468b89415056450de60ffc32b23381740b49e4b405c27.png] 

4) Only two persons sit between A and the one who is preparing for C3.

5) A is not neighbour of B.

As there is no possible position for C3 in case 1 and 3, therefore are eliminated.

After positioning A only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. C.

Case 3) 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/766c8ad0d209d885b2e7e3eabf7d15edb5237ee00b35dde0723fe86c5eebe512.png] 

6) One person sits between the persons who are preparing for C3 and C1. 

7) The one preparing for C1 sits to the immediate left of the one who is preparing for C5.

Case 3) 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1324db123250b53c6c385917e383bbff574af6e9c47cdb05b19472ce36dc35e7.png] 

8) C is not preparing for C4.

Case 3)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/daf548c0974605f33ee99902cc6bfaa76957bc6f379a205a05f06a1cbb572efc.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, C is preparing for C2.

Hence, **"Option 1"** is the correct answer.
